Jokers and Stars is a 9-reel,
8-line slot taking 1 to 8
coins per game.{ff01}{ff02}It has an Any Game and a Star Game.{ff01}{ff02}Line up 3 of the same symbol on
lines 1 to 8 to win. The coins you
bet set the number of lines.{ff01}{ff02}Circle raises your bet and X
lowers it. Press R1 to start.{ff01}{ff02}Press SELECT to bet
8 coins automatically.{ff01}{ff02}In the Any Game, you win with 4+
"6"s or BARs, or 5+ of any other
symbol, across the 9 reels.{ff01}{ff02}In the Star Game, 4 or more stars
on the 9 reels let you play
various features.{ff01}{ff02}Star Games are all replays,
so you don't lose coins.{ff01}{ff02}4 Stars is Star Hold: the stars
stay while the other reels spin.{ff01}{ff02}5 Stars is "6" Hold: the "6"s
stay while the other reels spin.{ff01}{ff02}6 Stars is Center Joker: the
middle reel turns into a Joker.{ff01}{ff02}Jokers are wild. If the same symbol
is on both sides, it counts as
three in a row.{ff01}{ff02}7 Stars is Cross Joker: the four
reels above, below, left and right
turn into Jokers.{ff01}{ff02}8 Stars is Corner Joker: the four
corner reels turn into Jokers.{ff01}{ff02}If a non-star symbol lands between
Jokers, it counts as three in a row.{ff01}{ff02}When you want to stop,
please press L1.{ff01}{ff02}Press R1 to start.
Please enjoy yourself.{ff01}
